interface.longDescription: Provides focused workflows for academic authoring, V3+ content revisions, blog editing, forms, media and operation recovery. The remote MCP server remains authoritative for current capabilities, environment identity, scopes, exact revisions, signed mutation plans, trusted evidence and explicit publication. The Admin website is optional for supported workflows.
defaultPrompt: Use only the zyx-stg MCP connection for this task. Do not substitute another Zyx environment.
Use advertised tool names from tools/list; dotted names in the skills identify operations. Keep dotted operation argument values unchanged.
Inspect admin.environment and admin.capabilities before managing content, forms, or other admin operations.
Run or resume the end-to-end authoring pipeline from course sources through validated Idea and Product Bundles.
Build a Source Pack from stored course PDFs and validate it through Zyx MCP.
Create an Idea draft from a validated Source Pack using the connected server's advertised draft contract and exact source quotes.
Create an Article or Diktat from published Ideas, verify V4 content with purpose logic without browser captures, and request purpose pdf only for final Diktat artifacts before authorized publication.
Revise one stored Idea or Product target using current revision identity and compact reads, then inspect full release context before review or publication.
Author an Idea-linked Question Bank draft for admin review.
Ingest stored historical question and solution PDFs into immutable attributed reference records.
